Hereditary amyloid protein deposition predominantly damages kidneys; GI involvement is frequent (30-79%). Hepatic, cardiac and peripheral nerve injury are generally <30%.
Corticospinal and sometimes peripheral nerve degeneration; weakness and amyotrophy are neurogenic, without established primary muscle disease.
Benign tumor originates from ectopic adrenal cortical tissue, establishing endocrine origin despite its testicular or ovarian location.
Congenital uterine, cervical and vaginal anatomy involves reproductive organs outside the axes.
Inherited melanin/melanosome disorder with defining foveal hypoplasia and visual impairment; freckling and giant skin melanosomes do not establish skin damage.
Gonadal failure/hypogonadism is defining and present in 80-99%; urethral malformations, including hypospadias and urogenital sinus anomalies, occur in 30-79%.

Developmental disability, epilepsy and sometimes lissencephaly define involvement; cafe-au-lait spots and retinal flecks do not establish skin or visual dysfunction.
Immune-mediated peripheral nerve/root injury; respiratory weakness and autonomic instability reflect neuropathy rather than direct lung or heart damage.
Adenomatous epithelial neoplasm originating in the colon.
Post-extraction clot loss exposes and inflames tooth-socket bone in the mouth; dry socket alone does not establish infection or allergic disease.
Defining congenital heart disease; intestinal malrotation 2/3, asplenia 1/3 and corpus callosum agenesis 1/3 support involvement, although the reported cohort is small.
Chronic venous valve/flow failure; edema alone is not skin damage. Damaging skin complications are not established in at least 30% across this broad concept.
Crouzon/craniosynostosis ancestry and the osteosclerosis synonym establish skeletal disease; associated ectodermal dysplasia establishes cutaneous involvement.
Severe neurodevelopmental disorder; hearing impairment affects 2/2 reported patients, supporting direct auditory dysfunction.
Reflex epilepsy with seizures triggered by hot water exposure; no other organ damage is established.
Allergic, immune-mediated disease located in the digestive tract.
The syndrome is defined by cervical hypertrichosis and underlying structural kyphoscoliosis.
ASD and brachydactyly/joint hypermobility each affect 3/3 reported patients. Constipation and skin hypopigmentation alone do not establish direct additional organ damage.
Autoimmune glomerular/podocyte disease causing proteinuria; anti-PLA2R antibodies support the immune mechanism.
Craniosynostosis and fibular aplasia define skeletal malformation; cryptorchidism is reproductive, and intelligence is normal.
